QuestInfo.name: Moonlight Sonata - Ask Wing the Fairy
QuestInfo.0: Visit #bWing the Fairy#k in #bEllinia#k like Cassandra told you to.
QuestInfo.1: Wing the Fairy tells you to bring something that she needs for her homework if you want to ask her something.  Perhaps a bright #brefined emerald#k?
QuestInfo.2: You gave Wing the Fairy the refined emerald and learned about Gold Richie. She told you that Gold Richie was bragging that he finally got the moonlight recently... \nIs that moonlight...?

0.0: What are you pestering me about this time? Got a question? Why should I answer your questions, huh? Wait! All right. If you can bring me what I need, I might be able to stick around to answer your question.

yes.0: Ah! Well, I was doing my homework and I ran out of #bRefined Emerald#k. If you can bring me that, I'll briefly answer your question.

no.0: If you don't want to do it, then forget it! I have better things to do. Get going!

1.0: Hm? You didn't bring one that was cracked or damaged, did you? Hmm... It looks fine. Well then, let's hear your question. What is it that you want to ask me?\r\n#L0##bDo you happen to know about a song called the Moonlight Sonata?#l\n#k
1.1: Moonlight Sonata? Never heard of it. Why is everyone looking for moonlight these days?\r\n#L0##bDid anyone else besides me ask about the Moonlight Sonata?#l\n#k
1.2: No, not the Moonlight Sonata. It's just that I saw Gold Richie recently grinning like a dope, saying , #b'the moonlight is finally in my hands.'#k I didn't like it at all. Are all humans like that?

yes.0: Well, I answered your question. I'll just be taking this emerald. You should leave now. I can't focus when a human is next to me.

item.0: Ah! Well, I was doing my homework and I ran out of #bRefined Emerald#k. If you can bring me that, I'll briefly answer your question.
